supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite plural group governed as the excepted class

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the ayah's compressed turn. It reaches backward to the universal human diagnosis in 70:19-21 and carves the named group out from within that same human field, so the exception is not a fresh subject break but a restriction on the prior claim. As the first word of the ayah, it lets the reader hear reversal before the identity of the exempted class appears. Its fixed particle shape carries the whole operation in one small form: scope, exclusion, and discourse pivot. In recitation, the phrase runs on into {{ar:ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ}} ({{tr:al-muṣallīna}}), making the particle's governance audible as well as grammatical.

topics.headline: exception scopes backward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word restricts the prior human diagnosis from inside it rather than starting an unrelated new statement.
topics.reason: Attachment and ellipsis evidence identify the particle as the exception marker whose domain is supplied by the preceding general human statement.

topics.headline: compressed hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the surah turn through a single particle that selects the counter-class and reverses the three-ayah portrait.
topics.reason: The local syntax makes exception and restriction active together, while the ayah boundary places that operation at the structural hinge.

topics.headline: reversal first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the boundary change from behavioral diagnosis to named exception before the group itself is named.
topics.reason: The fragmentary exception construction depends on the preceding predicate and makes the first token of 70:22 the audible boundary marker.

topics.headline: compact form joins forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a tiny fixed particle carries the grammatical turn and links directly into the governed noun in recitation.
topics.reason: The word is an uninflected exception particle, and the following noun begins with liaison, so the row-level form and sound claims fit the local phrase.

words.root_gloss_range: root family includes ritual prayer, supplication or blessing, fire exposure or heat, close following, and other lexical branches; local grammar selects the prayer-maintaining class while allowing controlled contrastive resonance from nearby branches

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the exception particle governing the noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ}} ({{tr:al-muṣallīna}}) names the exempted group, not an isolated devotional topic. Its definite plural and accusative ending make a recognizable collective stand under the exception particle as the subset excluded from the human weakness described in 70:19-21, and the liaison after that particle keeps even the noun's onset bound to the exception role. The Form II active participle turns prayer into durable identity: the ayah names prayer-maintainers, not people who merely happened to perform one act, and the doubled sound makes that Form II pressure audible. That class then becomes the head of the following catalogue, with prayer returning at 70:23 and 70:34. The root field adds controlled pressure: the selected sense is ritual prayer, while close-following, bodily posture, and the surah's earlier fire field (70:15) make the exception feel like a turn from withholding enclosure into maintained orientation and nearness, not into the fire-casting or fire-suffering branches. The same participial label also has a contrastive edge against 107:4-5, where prayer-performers are condemned when heedless. In the two-word ayah, the long plural cadence gives the named class the landing weight after the clipped exception particle.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as a definite masculine plural accusative noun governed as the excepted group.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar names a stable prayer-maintaining identity rather than reporting a single prayer event.
topics.reason: The local form is a Form II active participle and noun instance, so the participial class-label reading is directly supported.

topics.headline: known class with role marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices knownness, class plurality, backward dependency, and forward specification arriving together in the word's surface form.
topics.reason: The article, plural accusative ending, liaison after the particle, and exception syntax all converge on the local surface.

topics.headline: head of the virtue catalogue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the noun as the head that the following catalogue specifies, with prayer framing the catalogue at 70:23 and 70:34.
topics.reason: The exception scope is described as extending through 70:34, and the same root recurs in the catalogue at 70:23 and 70:34.

topics.headline: orientation and posture resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the prayer class as a posture of maintained orientation and nearness against the prior withholding posture.
topics.reason: The local sense remains ritual prayer, but accepted root branches for close following and embodied prayer language allow a controlled image-level resonance without replacing the selected sense.

topics.headline: fire field as contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's fire branches sharpen the local prayer reading by contrast with the earlier fire scene (70:15).
topics.reason: V4 accepts fire-exposure and heat branches for the root, but the local Form II active participle names prayer-maintainers, so fire remains contrastive resonance rather than the local sense.

topics.headline: Form II selects prayer agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the actual participial form selects active prayer-maintenance rather than fire-casting or fire-suffering agency.
topics.reason: The broader root family contains fire-related branches, but the local morphological form and grammar select the prayer-maintaining noun.

topics.headline: same label can indict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same prayer-performer label marks exemption here but indictment in 107:4-5 when heedlessness qualifies the practice.
topics.reason: The supplied cross-reference gives 107:4-5 as a concrete contrast for the same participial label.

topics.headline: two-beat landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a short exclusion beat followed by a sustained plural landing on the named counter-class.
topics.reason: The ayah contains the exception particle followed immediately by the long plural noun, so the structural and cadence rows fit the local phrase.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exceptive construction in إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ and the participial class name ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The exception identifies a class by prescribed, binding worship: a bounded embodied practice, not an unqualified virtue label.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship with its required postures supplies the literal ritual identity and its disciplined form.
Binding ritual worship supplies obligation, making the exception a practiced commitment rather than a momentary attitude.

changed_reading.before: The phrase merely names an unspecified favored group.
changed_reading.after: The exception is a class constituted by prescribed and binding embodied worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root inventory of ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ includes prayer as supplication, blessing, praise, and mercy.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside ritual performance, the class can be characterized by recurrent address beyond the isolated self: asking, blessing, praising, and seeking mercy.

activation_trace.role: Supplication, praise, and mercy supply an outward relational register for the class name.
Supplication, blessing, mercy, and forgiveness reinforce prayer as other-directed address as well as ritual.

changed_reading.before: The label refers only to performers of a ritual sequence.
changed_reading.after: The label can also foreground people habituated to supplication, blessing, and mercy toward others.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split root inventory attached to ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ includes meeting heat and straightening material by fire.
baseline_models.mechanism: A shadow model places prayer beside controlled exposure: the exception names people formed under pressure rather than people promised insulation from it.

activation_trace.role: Meeting fire, heat, and hardship supplies the literal pressure that the exceptional class is imagined as enduring.
Fire used to straighten material supplies a formative rather than merely punitive function for repeated prayer.

changed_reading.before: Prayer marks exemption by religious identity alone.
changed_reading.after: Prayer carries an exploratory image of controlled formation through heat and hardship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root inventory includes the racer who follows immediately behind the leader.
baseline_models.mechanism: A relational shadow reading sees the exceptional class as disciplined followers: close enough to track a lead, but not defined by winning first place.

activation_trace.role: The second horse following at the leader's flank supplies disciplined proximity as the class's relational posture.
The follower immediately behind the leader reinforces following without self-appointment as first.

changed_reading.before: The exception is a static identity category.
changed_reading.after: The exception can carry a shadow image of sustained, close, noncompetitive following.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate exception now functions as a response regulator. Prescribed prayer repeatedly inserts a stable practice between contact and reaction, so harm need not cut off patience and beneficial possession need not close the hand.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed embodied worship supplies the repeated counter-practice attached to the exception.
Inner disposition supplies the deep behavioral substrate that the prayer practice is inferred to retrain.
Anxious greed and rapid disturbance supply the unstable default from which the exception departs.
The arrival of an effect supplies the contact event that ordinarily releases panic.
Patience being cut off supplies the failure mode that disciplined prayer interrupts.
A second arriving effect supplies the symmetric contact event that releases possessiveness.
Generosity and gift within beneficial good expose the outward potential that withholding blocks.
Holding the hand back from giving supplies the second failure mode that the exception reverses.

structural_cues: 70:22 begins with an immediate إِلَّا after the paired contact-and-reaction clauses of 70:19-21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inward disposition, two contact events, panic, withholding, and prescribed worship; I infer that repeated worship retrains the contact-to-reaction interval. A live alternative is that prayer only marks the exceptional group without causing its regulation.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is a badge separating one group from anxious humanity.
changed_reading.after: Prayer is a practiced interruption of the touch-to-panic and touch-to-withholding reflexes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prayer becomes a temporal architecture spanning unstable perception. Patient self-restraint, the oscillation between far and near, continuity, and guarding all make the exception durable rather than episodic.

activation_trace.role: Binding ritual worship supplies the practice whose temporal durability is being tested.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the temporal restraint later embodied by continuous prayer.
Distance supplies one unstable horizon across which practice must persist.
Nearness supplies the opposed horizon, preventing persistence from depending on perceived delay.
Binding worship reappears in context as the object on which duration operates.
Stillness and continuance supply the explicit duration that converts prayer from event to stable rhythm.
Adherence and regular observance supply active maintenance at the sequence's closing return to prayer.

structural_cues: The early command to patience and the far/near contrast are followed by prayer described first as continuous and later as guarded.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, opposed temporal perceptions, continuity, and maintenance; I infer that prayer stabilizes conduct across changing horizons. Alternatively, these may be parallel virtues without a shared temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The exception names people who perform prayer.
changed_reading.after: The exception names people whose guarded prayer establishes a stable rhythm across delay, nearness, harm, and benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The supplicatory-mercy baseline becomes a counter to crisis atomization. Where terror silences intimate asking and turns kin into possible ransom for solitary escape, prayer preserves address, mercy, and relations that are not expendable instruments.

activation_trace.role: Supplication, praise, and mercy supply the other-directed practice contrasted with relational collapse.
Intimate kinship supplies the close relation whose mutual address fails under crisis.
Making one thing ransom for another supplies the conversion of relation into a self-rescue instrument.
Companionship and abiding proximity supply one bond exposed to instrumental sacrifice.
Brotherhood and kinship supply another bond that panic would exchange for escape.
Tender mercy toward one under care supplies the relational value inverted by the ransom wish.
Escape by separation supplies the solitary endpoint that merciful prayer resists as a social logic.

structural_cues: 70:10-14 moves from failed intimate asking through an expanding ransom list to hoped-for solitary rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies close bonds, ransom, care, separation, and prayer's mercy branch; I infer that merciful address opposes treating others as expendable means. Alternatively, the earlier crisis scene may expose panic without directly defining the later exception.

changed_reading.before: Supplicatory prayer is primarily a private request for one's own rescue.
changed_reading.after: Supplicatory prayer preserves other-directed mercy precisely where fear would silence or instrumentalize intimate relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prayer's mercy register is given an economic mechanism. A marked, fixed obligation in accumulated wealth makes giving prior to mood and responsive both to voiced request and unvoiced deprivation, reversing the closed hand.

activation_trace.role: Supplication, blessing, and mercy supply the relational disposition made concrete as an economic claim.
The hand held back from giving supplies the economic reflex that the exception must reverse.
Acquiring and increasing wealth supplies the stock within which another's claim is recognized.
A fixed, binding entitlement supplies obligation rather than discretionary generosity.
A distinguishing mark that guides to something supplies the share's prior specification and visibility.
Request and asking supply the voiced claimant whom the allocated right reaches.
Deprivation and loss of what is sought supply the claimant whose need may remain unvoiced.
Alms as a monetary right supplies a branch bridge between truthfulness and enacted distribution.

structural_cues: The withholding clause at 70:21 is interrupted by the exception and followed at 70:24-25 by a specified right for both asker and deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, accumulated wealth, a fixed marked right, and two claimant types; I infer that prayer externalizes mercy as preset circulation. A live alternative is that distribution is an adjacent trait rather than an effect of prayer.

changed_reading.before: Prayer's mercy is an inward sentiment or verbal benevolence.
changed_reading.after: Prayer's mercy is institutionalized as a prior claim on wealth that defeats reactive withholding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prayer brackets a custody regime. The same vigilance that maintains ritual extends across bodily boundaries, trusts, covenants, and testimony, so the exception is a transferable discipline of keeping rather than a compartmentalized rite.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship supplies the bounded practice whose discipline is extended into other domains.
Prescribed worship opens the contextual catalogue as its first maintained object.
Guarding sanctity, covenant, and chastity supplies bodily custody as one transfer of prayer's discipline.
Preserving something state after state supplies continuity in covenantal custody.
Watching and attending to an affair supplies active oversight rather than passive possession of a trust.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies the evidentiary object that must be kept intact.
Care, guarding, and oversight supply the active standing required for truthful testimony.
Prescribed worship returns at the catalogue's close, completing the ritual bracket.
Regular observance supplies the closing maintenance action and ties every custody domain back to prayer.

structural_cues: Prayer at 70:23 and 70:34 forms a verbal bracket around the catalogue in 70:24-33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prayer bracket and repeated keeping, watching, witnessing, and standing images; I infer a transferable custody discipline. Alternatively, the bracket may organize a list of independent qualities without making prayer their training mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is one item among several unrelated marks of the exceptional group.
changed_reading.after: Prayer frames a single custody discipline exercised over wealth, body, trust, covenant, evidence, and the rite itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The follower-at-the-flank branch becomes a contrast to acquisitive rushing. The exceptional posture is close, sustained following, while the later crowd hastens from desire, imagines entry, competes in precedence, and rushes toward an erected target.

activation_trace.role: The second racer following at the leader's flank supplies disciplined proximity without a claim to first place.
Hastening forward supplies the crowd's visibly eager but undisciplined approach.
Hopeful craving supplies the self-interested motive driving the crowd's approach.
Advancing and racing supply the competitive axis against which second-place following changes value.
Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the terminal image of urgent mass motion.
An erected visible object supplies the external target toward which speed is organized.

structural_cues: The branchless و ف ض occurrence at 70:43 is used only as a structural cue for rushing, not as a branch citation.
The sequence moves from an eager crowd before the addressee to desired entry, denied precedence, and mass speed toward a target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus branch for second-place following and context branches for haste, desire, racing, speed, and a target; I infer a contrast between disciplined following and acquisitive rushing. The live alternative is that the racing branch is only a form-distant homonym.

changed_reading.before: The prayer-doers are simply the group nearest the religious center.
changed_reading.after: In an exploratory shadow, they follow closely without turning proximity into a race for privileged entry.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the morphology and immediate continuation strongly favor ritual prayer. It remains anchored in both mapped focus inventories and in context images of molten matter, roasting heat, and sparks; downstream prose should present it only as a formative shadow image, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ through the focus branches for meeting heat and straightening material by fire.

activation_trace.role: Meeting fire and hardship supplies direct exposure rather than exemption from pressure.
Heating and turning material to straighten it supplies the outlier's formative mechanism.
Molten substances and deposits supply a world in which apparently stable form loses rigidity.
Cooking by heat supplies the dangerous thermal field that makes controlled straightening salient.
Flying sparks supply a compact heat image beside the human reaction sequence.

changed_reading.before: Prayer-doers are spared because they belong to a ritual category.
changed_reading.after: As a contained shadow image, prayer-doers are repeatedly straightened under controlled exposure before uncontrolled heat tests every form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain and branch-distant: the active participial form should not be translated as a trap. It remains worth carrying because the focus inventory explicitly contains snares while later context joins prayer-direction imagery, desire's net, and an erected target; downstream prose should qualify it as an anti-entitlement analogy. The branchless rushing root at 70:43 is only a structural cue.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ through the focus branch for snares and traps, held under the controlling ritual reading.

activation_trace.role: Snares and traps supply the focus-anchored image of a religious posture becoming a capture mechanism.
Direction faced in prayer supplies the spatial analogy that mere orientation can mimic devotion.
A trap in a net supplies desire's capture mechanism behind presumptive entry.
An erected visible object supplies the target that can organize captured mass motion.

changed_reading.before: Facing the right direction and crowding near a sacred center resemble membership in the exception.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, prayer must free orientation from desire's net; otherwise the visible target becomes a snare rather than a discipline.

strongest_changes: The immediate exception changes prayer from a group badge into a practiced regulator of panic and withholding.
Continuity and guarding make prayer a stable temporal rhythm rather than an episodic act.
The fixed known right turns prayer's mercy register into economic circulation for voiced and unvoiced need.
The prayer bracket around 70:24-33 makes ritual the frame for a broader custody discipline.
summary.what_was_special: A one-root focus with a split mapped inventory generated several coexisting mechanisms. The strongest context kept the ritual reading central while converting it into temporal, affective, economic, and custodial practice; form-distant heat, race, and snare images remained explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The context catalogue may describe correlated qualities rather than effects trained by prayer.
The heat, follower, and snare branches are visibly anchored but remain morphologically distant shadow readings.
The exact causal relation between private supplication, mercy toward kin, and preset economic rights remains inferential.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Prayer is the first named counter-system to panic and withholding.** *Al-muṣallīn* activates **ص ل و, B003, “the prescribed worship,”** and its immediate placement after 70:19–21 gives it an interrupting role. The following ayat specify duration, wealth circulation, accountability, guarded boundaries, covenant, and testimony. I infer that prayer is not an isolated badge but the recurring practice that coordinates these behaviors. The exception reads as entry into a different regulatory regime.

2. **Following closely is a latent image of disciplined alignment.** **ص ل و, B006, “following the leader in second place,”** is activated by the ordered chain of relative clauses through 70:34. Exploratorily, I infer that *muṣallīn* are characterized by sustained alignment rather than one-off ritual contact. This does not replace prescribed worship; it clarifies how the exception propagates through the list.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The closing return to guarded prayer in 70:34 made the exception’s architecture visible: prayer brackets the entire social and bodily discipline. The later ring corrected any reading of *muṣallīn* as an isolated ritual category.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimlerin ateş ve yakacak anlamlarını korurken yalnız belirli kuruluşlarda görülen ısınma, düzeltme ve zorluğa katlanma anlamlarını genelleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Ateşin içine girerek ya da yanında bulunarak onun yakıcı sıcaklığına maruz kalmayı anlatır; ateşte eti pişirme ile değneği ateşte yumuşatıp düzeltme gibi ateşle işleme anlamları belirli kuruluşlara bağlıdır. Ateşi besleyen yakacak adı ile bir işin ağır sıkıntısını çekme anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık ateşe girer, ateşin yanında kalır veya onun yakıcı sıcaklığını ve şiddetini çeker.
Kişi ateşin yanında durarak onun sıcaklığıyla ısınır.
Belirli kuruluşlarda et ateşte pişirilir veya değnek ateşte yumuşatılıp düzeltilir.
Ad biçimi ateşi tutuşturup sürdürmeye yarayan yakacağı, ayrıca ateşte pişirme işini belirtebilir.
Ateşin yakıcılığı, bir işin ağırlığını ve sıkıntısını çekmeye aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, ateşin sıcaklığını çekme ve ateşle işleme çekirdeğini; ısınma, pişirme, yakma, değnek düzeltme, yakacak ve ağır bir işe katlanma yönleriyle genişletir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü bir din topluluğunun kiliseleri, başka bir topluluğun tapınma yerleri ve daha genel olarak tapınma yeri adı şeklinde verir; sağlanan çerçeve bu çeşitliliği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Eylemin kendisi değil, tapınmaya ayrılmış yer adlandırılır; topluluğa özgü kilise kullanımı genel yer anlamına bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız yalın yer adlarını içerir ve başka dallardaki tapınma eylemi ya da dilek anlamlarını tanıma katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun tapınmasına ayrılmış yerin adıdır; özellikle Yahudilerin kiliseleri için kullanılır, bazı anlatımlarda Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir din topluluğunun topluca veya düzenli biçimde tapındığı yer adlandırılır.
Ad özellikle Yahudilerin kiliseleri için verilir; bazı anlatımlarda Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerine de uygulanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım sözcüğü tapınma yeri adı olarak açıklar; topluluğa özgü kullanım Yahudi kiliselerini öne çıkarırken başka bir aktarım Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerini de kapsar.

concept_gloss.text: tapınma yeri; kilise
concept_gloss.applicability: Genel tapınma yeri anlamını ve özellikle belirli din topluluklarının kiliseleri için kullanılan yer adını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınmaya ayrılmış yer çekirdeğini ve kilise olarak özelleşen kullanımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğul biçimin özellikle Yahudi topluluğunun kiliselerini adlandırdığı tarihsel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir topluluğa ait kiliseleri ve bunların tapınma yeri oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tapınma yeri anlamını ve Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerine uzanan aktarımı dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Yahudilerin kiliseleri veya bir din topluluğunun tapınma yerleri

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da tapınma yerini, özellikle Yahudilerin kiliselerini ve bazı anlatımlarda Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Sunulan kartlar yer türü, topluluklara uzanım veya eylem ile yer ayrımı bakımından bir sınır farkı göstermez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi geniş bir dövme taşını, üzerinde güzel kokulu maddelerin veya kurutulmuş yemişin dövülmesini ve taşın kaba, kalın bir levha görünümünü açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, malzemenin üstünde dövüldüğü geniş taş yüzeyidir; genel olarak her taş veya her dövme aracı kastedilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın taş adlarıyla sınırlıdır; ateş, tapınma, anatomi veya yalnız başka bir araçta görülen dövme anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Güzel kokulu maddeler veya kurutulmuş yemiş gibi malzemelerin üzerinde dövüldüğü geniş, kalın ve kaba taş yüzeyidir.

facets.statement: Geniş ve sert bir taş, malzemenin üstünde dövülüp ezildiği çalışma yüzeyi olarak kullanılır.
Taşın üzerinde güzel kokulu maddeler veya kurutulmuş yemiş dövülebilir.
Nesne kaba ve kalın bir taş levha görünümüyle de betimlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, üzerinde malzeme dövülen geniş taşı tanımlar; güzel kokulu madde ve kurutulmuş yemiş örneklerini verir ve taşın kaba, kalın yüzeyini belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: üzerinde dövme yapılan geniş taş
concept_gloss.applicability: Malzemenin içine değil üstüne konup dövüldüğü geniş, sert ve çoğu kez kaba taş yüzeyi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geniş taş yüzeyini, malzemenin onun üstünde dövülmesini ve araç işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güzel kokulu madde, kurutulmuş yemiş veya benzeri malzemenin üstünde ezildiği taş araç için doğal kısa karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Taşın malzemeyi dövüp ezmeye ayrılmış bir çalışma yüzeyi olmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da güzel kokulu madde veya kurutulmuş yemiş gibi malzemelerin üstünde dövüldüğü geniş ve kaba taşı tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu karttaki kaba ve geniş nesne benzetmesi, odak kaynağındaki kalın taş levha betiminden doğar ve temel sınırı değiştirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir malzemeyi vurarak ezme ve inceltme işinde kullanılan araçları adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü iri bir başağa sahip bitkiyi ve ona develerin ekmeği denmesini açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki develerin bu bitkiyi otladığı sonucu bu adlandırmadan anlaşılabilse de doğrudan söylenmediği için tanım bitkinin görünüşü ve deve yemi oluşuyla sınırlandırılmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal iri başaklı belirli bitkidir; genel otlak veya develerin yediği bütün bitkiler bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın bitki adı çekirdektir; bu bitkinin bulunduğu yeri bildiren yapı ayrı tutulur ve genel otlak anlamına genişletilmez.
